basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old fantasy enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me plenty of time to delve into the worlds of Sanderson, Rothfuss, and other fantasy greats. When I'm not working or reading, I'm probably hiking in the Cascades or experimenting with new recipes in the kitchen. I'm single, and my ideal weekend involves a good book, a cozy blanket, and a nice cup of tea. I typically browse Reddit in the evenings after dinner, around 7-10 PM PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep passion for epic fantasy literature, sparked by reading 'The Hobbit' as a child. Over the years, I've read extensively within the genre, expanding my collection and knowledge. My graphic design work has also led me to create fan art and participate in various online fan communities. I often engage with fellow fans to discuss theories and share insights.
